decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system fits the growing demand for flexible, representative workplaces, builds on the core office offer, and has its own page.
A chair family sits close to the established range and can be used across living and conference settings, so it is worth keeping after only one year.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory, but they are cheap to keep and support the curated-materials story, so the firm will likely retain them for now.
The soft sofa is core upholstery business, though it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower visibility while it is not yet a strong candidate for removal.
A high standing table complements the lounge and conference offer and needs few extra resources.
The rug collection is distant from the furniture core, but it is a designer-driven interiors extension with its own page, and premium firms usually give such collections more than one year.
